quotes.text: > Midian was the son of Abraham, by his second wife Kcturah. He and his posterity peopled the land, which was called after his name, and Jethro being the filth in regular descent from Midian, lived in the days of Moses, and was priest of the Most High God, when Moses was a young man, forty years before God culled him to lead Israel from Egypt.— (See Exodus iii. 1.)
